Saying goodbye to our beloved cat, Mr. Blue, was one of the most difficult moments we have ever faced. We are deeply grateful to the entire team at ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic (Miami) for the kindness, compassion, and professionalism they showed us throughout the process.

From the moment we called to schedule the appointment, everyone was patient, caring, and respectful. During our visit, the staff treated both Mr. Blue and our family with genuine empathy and dignity. They took the time to answer our questions, explain everything clearly, and make an incredibly painful experience as peaceful as possible.

The clinic is clean, well-maintained, and organized, and it is evident that the team is highly trained and dedicated to animal care.

Although our hearts are broken, we find comfort in knowing that Mr. Blue's final moments were handled with such tenderness and respect. Thank you for helping us say goodbye to a cherished member of our family.

We wholeheartedly recommend ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic (Miami) to anyone looking for compassionate, professional, and high-quality veterinary care. ❤️🐾

That night my dog got to his incision, I called the 24hr line & Jessica not only walked me through how to care for it but also scheduled an appointment the next day to make sure all was well. When I came back the next day I met Kay who was very funny and all good vibes! The vet tech & Doctor carefully looked at my boy & gave him all the necessities plus more to take home for a smooth recovery. I wish I could name everyone who make this place what it is. I had such a great experience with the ASPCA Community Veterinary Clinic! They neutered my dog Cloudie (mini poodle), who had a condition called cryptorchidism (where one of the testicles doesn’t descend) and they did an amazing job from start to finish.

It’s been 9 days now and Cloudie is recovering really well, everything looks great, and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome. The staff was incredibly friendly, considerate, and informative. They made sure I understood the procedure and aftercare, which gave me a lot of peace of mind.

Just a heads up: an appointment is required, but the process was smooth. I arrived a little after 8am to sign in and the wait time was less than an hour, which was very reasonable.

Overall, I would give them 6 stars if I could. Thank you, ASPCA for taking such good care of Cloudie!

I prepared with my vet with antibiotics and pain medication, as well as Donat for her neck and Ounbaon, which is a recovery medication.
But they didn't give any medication; they said they would give an injection. But the service and cleanliness were excellent. They do it parascopically, meaning they don't just paint on the outside. The best decision of my life. They also give all the vaccines.
